identity_panel.title: Identity Panel
identity_panel.about: Thin-bordered top panel that frames the ruler, banner and home system inputs.

ruler_header.title: Ruler Header
ruler_header.about: Title and hint text above the ruler name input.

ruler_input.title: Ruler Name Input
ruler_input.about: Text input widget where the ruler's name is typed.

banner_header.title: Banner Header
banner_header.about: Title and hint text above the banner colour grid.

banner_grid.title: Banner Colour Grid
banner_grid.about: Thin-bordered grid of banner colour tiles; hover highlights and a click picks the colour.

home_header.title: Home System Header
home_header.about: Title and hint text above the home system name input.

home_input.title: Home System Input
home_input.about: Text input widget where the home system's name is typed.

preview_panel.title: Preview Panel
preview_panel.about: Thin-bordered bottom panel framing the empire preview; its border is drawn over the picture.

preview_image.title: Homeworld Picture
preview_image.about: Homeworld artwork behind the preview, drawn with the zoom, crop and fade set in its style.

preview_header.title: Preview Header
preview_header.about: Centered heading of the empire preview, in capitals.

preview_banner.title: Preview Banner
preview_banner.about: The chosen banner colour's standard for the race, scaled to the box height.

preview_text.title: Preview Text
preview_text.about: Empire name with the ruler and home system lines, drawn with icons.

busy_panel.title: Progress Panel
busy_panel.about: Progress popup shown only while the setup chain runs; previewed in the editor.

busy_text.title: Progress Text
busy_text.about: Text inside the progress popup showing the current step and elapsed time; shown only while the chain runs.
